tagline: Blockchain-oriented ASIC chip design and cryptocurrency mining equipment manufacturer
hero_kpi_rationale: The gross margin of 21.4% in 2024 reflects a significant improvement linked to the rise in bitcoin price, demonstrated by a rebound of 4.6% in 2023. This metric captures the key dynamic of AGM's business model in the cryptocurrency mining sector.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross profit divided by revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved dramatically in 2024 (21.4% vs 4.6% in 2023). This increase is attributed to the rise in bitcoin price, which boosted selling prices of cryptocurrency mining machines while supply costs remained stable.
kpis.signal: Major improvement in gross profitability due to higher bitcoin price

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined to 18.6% in 2024 (5.9M / 32.0M) compared to 23.0% in 2023 (15.8M / 68.8M), reflecting a 53.4% drop in revenue that was not offset by proportional cost reductions.
kpis.signal: Significant contraction in operating margin despite gross margin improvement

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from the sale of cryptocurrency mining machines and computing equipment.
kpis.description: Revenue fell to 32.0M USD in 2024, down 36.8M USD (-53.4%) from 68.8M USD in 2023. The decline is primarily attributed to reduced sales contracts, absence of sales from two key products, and delayed delivery dates.
kpis.signal: Significant sales contraction due to reduced contracts and delivery delays

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income after taxes, including discontinued operations.
kpis.description: Net income rebounded to 3.1M USD in 2024 (0.13 USD per share) compared to a net loss of 7.4M USD in 2023 (-0.31 USD per share). The improvement is primarily due to reduced losses from discontinued operations (0.29M USD in 2024 vs 18.9M USD in 2023).
kpis.signal: Return to profitability driven by reduced losses from discontinued operations

risks.title: Unpredictable evolution of Chinese regulation
risks.score_rationale: Risk placed at the beginning of the document with highly intensive language ("constantly evolving", "material and adverse effect", "significantly decline or be worthless"). Repeated multiple times. Trend: stable but structural. Category weight: critical for operations in China.

risks.title: Future approval required for offshore listings
risks.score_rationale: Major risk repeated 3 times in the text with critical language ("cannot predict", "significantly decline or be worthless"). High uncertainty regarding timing and conditions. Central position within China-related risks.

risks.title: Dependence on dividends from Chinese subsidiaries
risks.score_rationale: Structural risk related to the BVI holding structure. Moderate language but direct impact on cash flow ("limit our ability to pay"). Chinese regulations restrict dividends to accumulated profits under Chinese accounting standards.

risks.title: FCPA and Chinese anti-corruption compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly mentioned in the China section. Moderate language but clear legal exposure. Applicable to operations in China and interactions with authorities/partners.

risks.title: Bitcoin protocol modified by major contributors
risks.score_rationale: Business-specific risk for AGM (crypto/Bitcoin activity). Moderate language ("could negatively impact"). Positioned in the business risk summary. Trend: stable but inherent to the sector.

risks.title: Unauthorized disclosure of sensitive client data
risks.score_rationale: Explicit business risk mentioned in the summary. Moderate language ("could harm"). Applicable if AGM collects/processes client data. Trend: stable but increasing in the fintech sector.

risks.title: Need for additional capital to support growth
risks.score_rationale: Standard business risk mentioned in the summary. Moderate language ("might require"). Applicable if rapid growth occurs. Trend: stable but contextual to strategy.

risks.title: Complex M&A procedures for Chinese acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Business risk specific to acquisitions in China. Moderate language ("could make it more difficult"). Applicable if pursuing external growth strategy. Positioned in the China risk summary.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention any artificial intelligence initiatives in the provided 10-K/20-F filings. The strategic positioning is focused on ASIC chip design, cryptocurrency mining equipment manufacturing, and financial technology software services.
